text:
deploy-bot: kicking off config-only change: geo weight rebalance + tighter batch cap. Canary 6% for 25m, window 19:00-21:00 UTC. Patch: boost eu-west weight +14, reduce us-east weight -8, batch_max_tokens=18, per_router_concurrency=5, request_timeout_ms=1500. Health posts every 5m.

tay: short rationale 14 aim to shave p99 tails in EU without touching model versions. Exclude stress-tenant and benchmark-qa from canary.

samir: agree on exclusions. Add infra guard: immediate drain on OOM, mark node unhealthy for 10m.

ops-bot: exclusions applied [stress-tenant, benchmark-qa]. oom_drain=true; unhealthy_ttl_min=10.

ela: rollback criteria: abort if eu p99 > 1100ms or total_error_rate +1.2% abs or infra_ooms >=2 in 15m. Also watch kv_cache_miss + shard_queue_length.

tay: runbook snippet below for ops channel paste:

```yaml
change: config-only
canary:
  initial_pct: 6
  duration_min: 25
  step_up: [18,30]
routing_weights:
  eu-west-1: +14
  us-east-1: -8
batching:
  max_tokens: 18
  per_router_concurrency: 5
timeouts_ms: 1500
exclusions: [stress-tenant, benchmark-qa]
autoscaler:
  oom_drain: true
  unhealthy_ttl_min: 10
rollback_triggers:
  eu_region_p99_ms: 1100
  error_rate_abs_pct: 1.2
  infra_ooms_15m: 2
```

deploy-bot: canary started 2026-09-02T19:03:09Z. Observability links: /dash/route-weights, /dash/batch-traces. Paging to @tay and @ela.

(5m) ops-bot: health: eu p50 70ms p95 330ms p99 890ms, error_rate +0.2%, kv_cache_miss +0.4% 14 within guardrails.

(14m) samir: one node hit an OOM and was drained automatically; replacement healthy, no client-visible errors.

(26m) ela: green to step to 18%. Proceed to next hold and then to 30% if still green.

tay: drafting release note: "Config-only: favor eu-west (+14) and reduce batch_max_tokens to 18; request timeout 1500ms. Canary 6% -> 18% -> 30% on green. Exclusions: stress-tenant, benchmark-qa. Rollback thresholds documented. Autoscaler oom drain active."

deploy-bot: available commands `/deploybot abort-config` to revert, `/deploybot show-exclusions`. Next health post in 5m with slow-trace attachments.
